environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. ALB forwards all HTTP traffic to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to EC2 on 8080. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the ALB. The application is served via gunicorn with 4 workers.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, default routing rule to target group
config.network: VPC with public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound
